mapper.sql: r.id, r.registration_no AS registrationNo, r.competition_id AS competitionId, r.captain_id AS captainId, r.team_display_name AS teamDisplayName, r.status, r.row_version AS rowVersion, r.submitted_at AS submittedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM registration r WHERE r.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM registration r WHERE r.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

where.if: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM registration_member m WHERE m.registration_id = r.id AND m.student_id = #{studentId} AND m.invitation_status = 'CONFIRMED')

mapper.select: SELECT , c.name AS competitionName, c.entry_mode AS entryMode, c.registration_closes_at AS registrationClosesAt, c.correction_closes_at AS correctionClosesAt, c.submission_closes_at AS submissionClosesAt, c.current_publication_id IS NOT NULL AS hasResult FROM registration r JOIN competition c ON c.id = r.competition_id ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM registration r JOIN competition c ON c.id = r.competition_id

SELECT m.student_id AS studentId, m.is_captain AS isCaptain, m.invitation_status AS invitationStatus, p.full_name AS fullName, p.verification_status AS verificationStatus, a.status AS accountStatus, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_role ur JOIN role ro ON ro.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = a.id AND ro.role_code = 'STUDENT') AS studentRole FROM registration_member m JOIN student_profile p ON p.user_id = m.student_id JOIN user_account a ON a.id = m.student_id WHERE m.registration_id = #{id} ORDER BY m.is_captain DESC, m.student_id

SELECT id, actor_id AS actorId, from_status AS fromStatus, to_status AS toStatus, reason, roster_snapshot AS rosterSnapshot, created_at AS createdAt FROM registration_review_log WHERE registration_id = #{id} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT r.id AS registrationId, r.registration_no AS registrationNo, r.team_display_name AS teamDisplayName, c.name AS competitionName, m.invitation_status AS invitationStatus FROM registration_member m JOIN registration r ON r.id = m.registration_id JOIN competition c ON c.id = r.competition_id WHERE m.student_id = #{studentId} AND m.is_captain = FALSE AND m.invitation_status IN ('INVITED','CONFIRMED','DECLINED') ORDER BY r.id DESC

SELECT p.user_id FROM student_profile p JOIN user_account a ON a.id = p.user_id WHERE p.invite_code = #{code} AND p.verification_status = 'VERIFIED' AND a.status = 'ACTIVE' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_role ur JOIN role ro ON ro.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = p.user_id AND ro.role_code='STUDENT')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO registration(registration_no, competition_id, captain_id, team_display_name) VALUES(#{registrationNo}, #{competitionId}, #{captainId}, #{teamDisplayName})
INSERT INTO registration_member(registration_id, student_id, is_captain, invitation_status, confirmed_at) VALUES(#{id}, #{studentId}, #{captain}, #{status}, #{confirmedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE registration_member SET invitation_status = #{status}, confirmed_at = #{confirmedAt} WHERE registration_id = #{id} AND student_id = #{studentId} AND is_captain = FALSE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM registration WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'DRAFT'
mapper.update: UPDATE registration SET team_display_name = #{name}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE registration SET status = #{status}, row_version = row_version + 1, submitted_at = COALESCE(#{submittedAt}, submitted_at) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE registration SET row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO participation_claim(competition_id, student_id, registration_id, claimed_at) VALUES(#{competitionId}, #{studentId}, #{id}, #{now})
INSERT INTO registration_review_log(registration_id, actor_id, from_status, to_status, reason, roster_snapshot, created_at) VALUES(#{id}, #{actorId}, #{from}, #{to}, #{reason}, #{snapshot}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM registration r WHERE r.competition_id = #{competitionId} AND r.status IN ('PENDING','CHANGES_REQUESTED') ORDER BY r.id FOR UPDATE

SELECT x.outcome_status AS outcomeStatus, x.outcome_reason AS outcomeReason, CAST(x.total_score AS CHAR) AS totalScore, x.rank_no AS rankNo, x.award_name AS awardName, x.work_title_snapshot AS workTitle FROM registration r JOIN competition c ON c.id = r.competition_id JOIN competition_result x ON x.publication_id = c.current_publication_id AND x.registration_id = r.id WHERE r.id = #{id}
